event: Nala turns Shaestrel round and starts on the hooks at her nape.
Nala undoes the hooks one by one, kissing her back as she goes down, an inch at a time.
Shaestrel goes still, and her breath changes as Nala works down her spine.
The last hook gives at the waist, and Shaestrel holds the bodice to her front.
She says, unsteady, that Nala will want to hang the gown up.
She lets the gown go, and it pools grey-green on the floorboards.

changes.note: Gown off: it lies on the back-room floor
changes.from: A finished grey-green silk gown, hem set, now worn by Shaestrel; an arm's length of spare silk stays with Nala.
changes.to: A finished grey-green silk gown, hem set, lying where it fell on the back-room floor; an arm's length of spare silk stays with Nala.

memory.fact: The silk shifts between grey and green as it moves, like new leaves in rain.

event: She turns round and pulls Nala's face down to hers.
